metadata.name: coffre
metadata.description: Delegated, capped, on-chain trading vault for a MetaDAO treasury

accounts.name: manager
docs: Pays the Card rent, the coffre's NFT ATA and the marketplace listing rent.

accounts.name: asset_id
docs: The NFT mint.

accounts.name: source
docs: The treasury's token account for this NFT.

accounts.name: vault_usdc
docs: The treasury's USDC account. Squads checks `token::authority = vault`.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Creates the config for a multisig. Permissionless: the authority is
derived, the marketplace is fixed, and every policy field is
overwritten by the DAO's `set_policy` proposal.

accounts.name: manager
docs: Pays the listing rent.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The treasury vault PDA. Only signs inside a passed proposal (Path A).

types.name: Card
docs: One per NFT the coffre holds. PDA: ["card", coffre, mint].

fields.name: cost_basis
docs: USDC base units paid on purchase, or the value declared by the depositing proposal.

fields.name: listing
docs: Current listing PDA if listed, else default.

types.name: Coffre
docs: One per Squads multisig. PDA: ["coffre", multisig].

fields.name: multisig
docs: Squads multisig this coffre serves.

fields.name: authority
docs: Treasury vault (index 0) of that multisig. The only authority for privileged ops.
Derived at init, never taken from an argument.

fields.name: spending_limit
docs: Spending limit the coffre draws from. Its destinations must be exactly [coffre]
and its members must contain the coffre. Default = not set yet.

fields.name: manager
docs: Who may trigger trades. Pubkey::default() = nobody.

fields.name: allowed_collection
docs: Metaplex collection mint the trades are restricted to.

fields.name: marketplace
docs: Marketplace program. Always MARKETPLACE_PROGRAM_ID; stored for clients.

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: The marketplace's USDC mint, read from its Market account at init.

fields.name: max_per_tx
docs: Max `expected_price` (USDC base units) per single purchase.

fields.name: max_purchases_per_period
docs: Optional second cap: purchases per period. 0 = unlimited.

fields.name: min_sale_bps
docs: A card may not be listed below cost_basis * min_sale_bps / 10_000.

types.name: Policy
docs: Policy arguments shared by `initialize` and `set_policy`.
